title: nerium undulatum
intro: Nerium undulatum, commonly known as California oleander, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Apocynaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, due to its ability to lower cholesterol levels and prevent the formation of blood clots. The therapeutic actions of Nerium undulatum involve its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various conditions, including arthritis, gout, and other inflammatory diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include oleandrin, neriine, and neriifolin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
